verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing exposes a full programmatic Subscriptions API (create, change plan, proration preview) and an official MCP server letting AI agents interact with the Stripe API, which supports the 'agent operates billing programmatically' story. However, the evidence never documents scoped/restricted permission controls for agent access, nor explicit 'apply a credit' functionality, so the scoped-permission and credit-specific parts of the story are unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented scoped/restricted API key or permission model for agent use, explicit credit-application API evidence, and independent corroboration of the MCP server's agent workflows.
